description.en: Penthouse in London, United Kingdom. The residence is laid out over 520 m² and comprises 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms. The asset is ready to occupy. The listing has been verified by the XARU HOME desk and its documentation reviewed. This record is platform demonstration inventory: the structure, the workflow and the data model are the production ones, the asset is not.
